# Gauswarn India - Pure A2 Gir Cow Ghee

> Gauswarn India is a trusted brand by Rajlakshmi Javiks International, offering 100% pure, traditional bilona-made A2 Gir Cow Ghee, sourced from grass-fed indigenous Gir cows and prepared using Ayurvedic methods. Available in 250ml, 500ml, 1 Litre, 5 Kg, and 15 Kg packs with free shipping across India.
